parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the classic network type instance. You can invoke [DescribeInstances](~~25506~~) to query your active instances.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC for which you enable ClassicLink. You can invoke [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) to query your active VPCs.
